definitions.explanation: An object that produces a magnetic field and attracts iron and certain other metals.

examples.japanese: {磁石|じしゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}きつける→引き付ける：06791_hikitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I attract iron with a magnet.

notes:
{磁石|じしゃく} means magnet — an object that attracts iron and other ferromagnetic materials.
